qualification.scope: Public-owned Kokoro lossless long-speech correction, synthetic source contracts and bounded real local CPU synthesis; no installed-app, release or deployment qualification.
qualification.source_integrity: 2493 source files verified against a manifest bound to the real source commit; all six retained SBOM hashes/component counts verified; exactly four reviewed source/vendor paths plus manifest/binding change. Independent offline reverse/reapply reconstructs all ten pinned upstream files and the exact repaired fork; strict outer patch replay matches every source byte.
qualification.python_checks: Exact normal public unittest discovery passes 194 tests without failures/errors/skips. Fourteen focused real-wrapper/tokenizer tests pass. The original negative control yields 37 failing subcases plus two expected behavior errors for empty concatenate and stream-error timeout. Independent review reproduces regressions and checks final artifact bytes, unchanged existing assertions and source verifier. Existing Linux Python 3.12 tooling and four fail-loud unused optional import leaves support full-suite execution; no packages or models were acquired.
qualification.chunking_contract: Phoneme strings split into exact contiguous nonempty spans of at most 510 characters, preferring punctuation then whitespace before a hard boundary. Model tokens appear in their original order exactly once, subject only to unchanged vocabulary filtering. Existing direct-call tokenizer validation replaces silent slicing. Both model input conventions, voices/styles, speed representations, trimming and locale arguments are preserved.
qualification.customer_path_reproduction: The actual legacy phonemizer turns 150 space-separated hello words (899 text characters) into 1049 tokens. Original desktop synthesize/chunk methods pass all 899 characters unchanged. Original wrapper counting-session calls contain 0 then 510 tokens, losing 539; corrected calls contain 504, 504 and 41 tokens with zero loss. This original evidence is not an installed-customer or actual original audio-loss observation.
qualification.local_model_synthesis: Using already present legacy pronunciation and CPU ONNX assets, repaired sync and stream each synthesize all 1049 tokens into 1174800 finite nonzero float32 samples at 24000 Hz (48.95 seconds), bit-identical across sync/stream. Short default speech and blended-style 1.25-speed trimmed speech match the original bitwise; all 54 voice IDs remain. Seven actual locale fixtures retain identical pronunciation bytes; the bundled backend rejects the same existing fr and zh aliases before and after. All nine locale argument paths are covered synthetically; no multilingual-quality claim.
qualification.cancellation_and_failure: The producer task is owned and cancelled/awaited on cancellation or generator close; failures wake the consumer and propagate. Empty sync output is a one-dimensional empty float32 array at 24000 Hz and empty streaming yields nothing. A native inference already running may finish, while remaining batches stop. No hard native cancellation guarantee.
